en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When the one in Ihraam washes from the sexual impurity, he can pour (water) upon his head and separate the hairs by his fingers, from each other’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad from Hariz who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

If one who is in the state of Ihram takes Ghusl (bath) due to sexual relation (because of which Ghusl (bath) is obligatory), he can pour water over his head and separate the hairs from each other with his fingers.’”
